assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: The scan's verdict; set only when `status` is `completed`. A `warn` can mean a `fail` that was allowed in claude.ai.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The primary mechanism behind a `warn` or `fail`, such as `credential-exposure` or `guardrail-tampering`; a mechanism this API does not yet name reads as `other`. Null on a `pass`, whenever `assessment` is null, and when no mechanism is reported for the verdict.

status.title: Status
status.description: `processing` while a scan runs, `completed` when it ran to completion, `errored` when it could not run. Once a scan of the version has completed, `content_scan` describes the newest completed scan, even while a later scan runs. While the scan outcome cannot be read, `status` is `errored` instead.
